description: The bar chart titled "QA-1" compares the performance of three different language models: Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our) in terms of their accuracy in answering financial questions. The horizontal axis represents the categories of answers, which are "Correct," "Partially Correct," and "Incorrect." The vertical axis is not labeled with a scale but shows the proportion of each type of answer. The Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B model has a "Correct" answer rate of 0.88, a "Partially Correct" rate of 0.08, and an "Incorrect" rate of 0.04. The EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 model has a "Correct" answer rate of 0.96, a "Partially Correct" rate of 0.04, and an "Incorrect" rate of 0.04. The RedWhale model, which is the focus of the paper, also has a "Correct" answer rate of 0.96, a "Partially Correct" rate of 0.04, and an "Incorrect" rate of 0.04. The bars are color-coded with "Correct" in dark blue, "Partially Correct" in medium blue, and "Incorrect" in light blue. The chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
